pairing_qr.description: In the OpenPlate app, open Connection, select Scan Home Assistant QR code and scan this code. Then select Submit. The code expires after 10 minutes.

init.title: Manage OpenPlate
init.description: Choose what you want to configure.

plates.title: Registered plates
plates.description: Add, rename or remove plates. Changes are applied after submitting.

data_description.plates: One plate per line as PLATE=Display name. Spaces and hyphens in the plate are normalized.

pairing.title: Pair an iPhone
pairing.description: Pairing generates a new signing key. The previous iPhone connection remains valid until you confirm the QR-code screen.

data_description.home_assistant_url: HTTPS base URL reachable from the mounted iPhone.

pairing_qr.title: Scan the pairing code
pairing_qr.description: Scan this code in the OpenPlate iPhone app first. Then select Submit to activate the new key. The code expires after 10 minutes and the previous app key will stop working.
